howto.name: Paste a .env file
howto.text: Drop environment variable lines into the browser-only editor.

howto.name: Review warnings
howto.text: The validator catches missing equals signs, invalid names, duplicate keys, empty values, unquoted spaces, and short-looking secrets.

howto.name: Fix and copy
howto.text: Update your .env file until the report is clean, then copy the corrected content back to your project.

faq.a: No. It is a fast syntax and hygiene check. Use dedicated secret scanning before committing any real credentials.

faq.q: Will it reveal my secrets to PrivaTools?
faq.a: No. The .env text stays in browser memory and is never sent to the backend.
